text:
Tom: Heads-up — Nebula Systems QBR is on the calendar for next Tue 10am PT. We need a short token econ + spend forecast, renewal risk signal, and enablement plan. Who can take the forecast?
Mei: I can run the forecast if Raj can pull the per-model usage breakdown.
Raj: On it. pulling last 90 days now — will post quick table. :mag:
billing-bot: Alert: Nebula Systems monthly spend breached the soft threshold yesterday (auto-email sent).
Ava: Noted. I'll prep an enablement slide with action items for their platform engineers. Need pointers on model mix and heavy endpoints.
Mei: Raj — send model mix + p50/p95 latency slice. Also include embedding vs. generation split.
Raj: Quick dump: 
```
last_90d_total_tokens: 42,300,000
generation_tokens: 28,700,000
embedding_tokens: 13,600,000
top_models: redwood-4b-q5 (45%), openlm-13b (30%), embed-lite (25%)
avg_monthly_spend: $16,800
monthly_trend: +42% (last 30d vs prior 30d)
```
Raj: Uploading full csv to: https://drive.redwood.internal/nebulasys/qbr_forecast.csv
Ava: Thanks. For the slide, call out embedding-heavy route and two ops recommendations: (1) move high-volume embeds to batch/async, (2) enable prefix caching for frequent prompts.
Tom: Good. Risk note: account has no renewal comms yet and usage spike + forecasted burn puts them in mid-risk band. Add renewal play: 30-min technical workshop + cost optimization pilot.
Mei: I'll create the token-econ readout — short bullets + a one-slide forecast table. Draft by EOD Friday?
Ava: EOD Fri works. I'll draft enablement checklist and a one-click steps doc for their engineers.
Raj: CSV and short charts done. One ask: can we estimate cost impact if they quantize openlm-13b to int8? Rough calc below.
Mei: Nice — include that as a scenario. If int8 reduces per-token by ~35% on that route, overall spend drops ~10%. Add as "cost levers" in QBR.
Tom: OK owners: Mei = token econ & forecast, Raj = usage data & charts, Ava = enablement slides + workshop logistics. I'll own renewal outreach and runbook for short-term throttle.
Ava: I'll ping partner success to schedule the workshop once deck is ready. @Tom can you draft the outreach template?
Tom: Will do — short, technical-first ask + time options.
Mei: Final ask — anyone with recent embed-caching playbook examples? could copy a short snippet to include. :pray:
Raj: I'll attach a snippet from a previous account under /templates/embed_caching.md
Tom: Great. If we all hit our bits by Fri EOD, we'll have a 10-slide QBR and an enablement checklist for Monday prep. :thumbsup:
Ava: Sounds good. I'll also add a renewal risk flag in Salesforce after the outreach.
billing-bot: Note: next invoice due in 9 days; consider prepay/commit options in the QBR deck.
Tom: Thanks team — sync tomorrow 10am to review draft.
Mei: See you then.
Raj: ack.
Ava: ack :eyes:
